fc27d44b-0690-4efa-9778-1ab3e5e97946.name: Handiski ESF Morzine
fc27d44b-0690-4efa-9778-1ab3e5e97946.description: Lessons or guiding for skiers with physical or mental disabilities

e89e455c-60c3-4b79-afcd-9d08be10a917.name: Sledging
e89e455c-60c3-4b79-afcd-9d08be10a917.description: Reserved for people who want to have fun!

5933e369-f2e6-4b43-acb2-ad458ea27300.name: Airéole - Paragliding School in Morzine
5933e369-f2e6-4b43-acb2-ad458ea27300.description: Accredited by the FFVL since 1987, the Airéole professional school invites you to take to the skies in the heart of the fabulous Portes du Soleil ski area.

6c4b5220-3bbd-4350-ba9d-58153bdf7943.name: Avokart
6c4b5220-3bbd-4350-ba9d-58153bdf7943.description: With Avokart, race down the slopes like you've never done before!

834ac0ef-09fa-4326-b705-434a10af56d8.name: Snowshoeing walk with Evolution 2
834ac0ef-09fa-4326-b705-434a10af56d8.description: Discover the mountain, snowshoes on your feet and enjoy the calm of nature. Our Evolution 2 guides will make you live a unique moment in an exceptional setting.

83578d65-5e8c-48cf-839d-0e1f9144c21b.name: Guided snowmobile tours
83578d65-5e8c-48cf-839d-0e1f9144c21b.description: At nightfall, the snow becomes a terrain to discover our mountains from a different perspective. With friends, family, or alone, you will take pleasure in driving a motorized vehicle while enjoying the panorama.

ec4483f4-4875-4742-a4f8-7b6672963db8.name: Walks & Hikes with Montagne Aventure by ESI Morzine
ec4483f4-4875-4742-a4f8-7b6672963db8.description: Guided walks and hikes with a certified guide for all skill levels: chairlift rides in the Portes du Soleil, challenging hikes, themed outings, orienteering, and donkey rides.

39b92c5d-7c52-418d-9361-73bfe3be59e7.name: Helicopter baptism
39b92c5d-7c52-418d-9361-73bfe3be59e7.description: You want to make your first helicopter flight?

9ed55f6c-9f16-4876-829b-46436e47351e.name: Paragliding experience with Évolution 2
9ed55f6c-9f16-4876-829b-46436e47351e.description: Evolution 2 offers paragliding flights in winter and summer. Would you like to make your first flight with certified instructors? Fly in a unique setting and live an exceptional moment by discovering the beauty of nature from the air.

f005c48d-9b90-489a-9247-3a8bc6676ef6.name: Speed Riding with Airéole Paragliding School
f005c48d-9b90-489a-9247-3a8bc6676ef6.description: Between skiing and paragliding, sometimes on snow sometimes in the sky, speed riding offers unique sensations ! It's time to get started ! Ski level: good skier required

f8f24309-81fd-4d74-9bf2-e2e073635e83.name: Paragliding baptisms and Discovery tandem flights with AERO-Bi
f8f24309-81fd-4d74-9bf2-e2e073635e83.description: Spend a magical and unforgettable moment with Aero-Bi! We'll take you flying in a two-seater paraglider above Morzine, in complete safety, with a state-licensed paragliding pilot on hand from the moment you arrive.

1abde295-e91f-4506-b5aa-e2a1b7996141.name: "Le Vieux Pont" Library
1abde295-e91f-4506-b5aa-e2a1b7996141.description: The library offers you a wide choice of children's and adult books, books in English as well as bilingual books (Spanish, English, Portuguese, Russian, German), games, magazines, CDs, read novels, local backgrounds, etc.

e0b02557-940a-4516-acb4-c6dc92db383b.name: Bowling - Woody
e0b02557-940a-4516-acb4-c6dc92db383b.description: WOODY has six state-of-the-art bowling lanes, equipped to accommodate both casual players and experienced enthusiasts.

f4de076a-7d99-40b9-ae83-dd5c9494da01.name: Bubble Foot
f4de076a-7d99-40b9-ae83-dd5c9494da01.description: Protected by a bubble, come and take a tumble in complete safety.

85aa309e-ad06-47e9-b52b-cbea38369d40.name: Equestrian Center
85aa309e-ad06-47e9-b52b-cbea38369d40.description: A true paradise for nature and horse lovers! Nestled in the heart of the majestic Haute-Savoie Alps, at an altitude of 1000 meters, our equestrian center offers a unique equestrian experience in an exceptional natural setting.

3aac4357-f0b6-4a01-a527-6e81067d53d0.name: Cinema Le Rex
3aac4357-f0b6-4a01-a527-6e81067d53d0.description: Do you fancy seeing a good film or the latest blockbuster that all your friends are talking about ? Make sure you're sitting comfortably in the projection room of the Rex cinema.

4b54ed1c-b557-4d1e-81a1-6b04181dfb0d.name: Snowboard group lessons
4b54ed1c-b557-4d1e-81a1-6b04181dfb0d.description: Achieve your goals in a lesson designed just for you. Private lessons are the best way to progress.

057d2d01-091c-40cc-9927-2e884a3b087a.name: Ski Lessons with BASS
057d2d01-091c-40cc-9927-2e884a3b087a.description: BASS, the British ski school in the French Alps since 1991, offers lessons for English speakers with ISTD Level 4 certified instructors in small groups tailored to your needs.

a5b3df0f-0707-4ea1-bfe6-0f07e2e30e28.name: Ski touring courses with FollowMetoSki
a5b3df0f-0707-4ea1-bfe6-0f07e2e30e28.description: Private ski touring outings and lessons for children and adults, all levels. Tailored guidance to progress safely, build confidence and discover the winter mountains.

8ad1ed61-ede0-44b6-939e-4d7904d5ed59.name: Ski touring with Marco Deshayes
8ad1ed61-ede0-44b6-939e-4d7904d5ed59.description: Full or half-day to either discover, even challenging on ski mountaineering to broaden the ski domain.

67ab40a4-f19c-4367-b295-790481d8aa08.name: Ski touring lessons with the B ski School
67ab40a4-f19c-4367-b295-790481d8aa08.description: Ski touring is one of the most beautiful ways to discover the mountain.

8b3d2d4d-884f-41e9-8455-f718daed129e.name: Ski touring lessons - group or individual with the ESF
8b3d2d4d-884f-41e9-8455-f718daed129e.description: Cross-country skiing For the day, or over several days, this way of exploring the mountains allows you to discover untouched areas far away from the busy ski trails.

6affb98a-802c-4ba2-9c72-6d03264f505f.name: Ski touring lessons - group or individual
6affb98a-802c-4ba2-9c72-6d03264f505f.description: Cross-country skiing For the day, or over several days, this way of exploring the mountains allows you to discover untouched areas far away from the busy ski trails.

fdadc633-84b9-42f2-be2a-2714ae1a1945.name: Snowboard Lessons with BASS
fdadc633-84b9-42f2-be2a-2714ae1a1945.description: BASS Snowboard lessons: professional instructors for English speakers, in small groups (max 4), since 1991.

909dd409-9b8e-41c6-84c6-bf13f56d095a.name: Speed riding lessons with ABC Ecole des portes du soleil
909dd409-9b8e-41c6-84c6-bf13f56d095a.description: Speed riding is an outdoor sport combining paragliding and skiing. Equipped with a small glider, and a pair of skis, you can then alternate flying and gliding on the safe and attractive pleney slope, awarded for teaching disipline. All the equipment: glider+harness+headset+radio are included. At your expense: skis and ski pass for the pleney.

85711067-59db-415a-8726-113bfc5f655f.name: Cours d'initiation au ski de hors pistes avec Airéole
85711067-59db-415a-8726-113bfc5f655f.description: With or without the help of ski lifts, conquer the peaks large and small that you can find in our amazing part of the world. Athleticism, peacefulness, pleasure, and contentment are guaranteed.

a0012c2b-c85c-4f24-88a3-a016a547ba16.name: Introductory off-piste skiing course with ESF
a0012c2b-c85c-4f24-88a3-a016a547ba16.description: Explore off-piste skiing in the local area with an instructor, learn about avalanche safety equipment (transceiver, shovel, probe...), security techniques and about snow and its different forms.

49a4fda8-8f54-4d5f-9e01-712fc33c7821.name: Introduction to ski touring with the Bureau des Guides
49a4fda8-8f54-4d5f-9e01-712fc33c7821.description: Far away from the ski-lifts, set off in search of untouched snow, off the beaten track accompanied by one of our guides who will choose a route suitable for your level and the snow conditions.

1b1019a3-dadf-4eda-a6ad-502d5fd3f5f4.name: Freestyle Snowboarding Lessons
1b1019a3-dadf-4eda-a6ad-502d5fd3f5f4.description: We offer dedicated freestyle lessons for all levels, whether you are new to freestyle, wish to perfect your halfpipe skills or even learn new rail tricks.

a70b4727-303c-4b90-bb2f-7af6563b5efa.name: Speed Riding Discovery
a70b4727-303c-4b90-bb2f-7af6563b5efa.description: A sport involving skiing, paragliding and sky-diving, the aim being to get down steep slopes on skis with a harness and small sail!

fddad463-4837-49c5-87df-13219c238791.name: Sledging by night
fddad463-4837-49c5-87df-13219c238791.description: When the sun goes down, come and sledge down the slopes from Avoriaz to Morzine: a relaxed atmosphere and plenty of laughs await! 1 descent in complete safety... Sledge + Helmet + Headtorch supplied. Suitable for all.

474c2254-4481-4e08-a3c9-574b22609b2c.name: Morzine ski area
474c2254-4481-4e08-a3c9-574b22609b2c.description: Welcome to the Morzine ski area. Along with the Pleney, Nyon and Chamossière sectors, the Pleney company manages half of the Morzine-Les Gets area.

afef0f75-72a3-4a99-accb-114d80495af5.name: Church Sainte Marie Madeleine
afef0f75-72a3-4a99-accb-114d80495af5.description: Church built in 1825 with canopy roof and carved 16th-century stalls

ef0d6159-3759-419e-b96a-01db43e012b3.name: Apéritif Escape Game
ef0d6159-3759-419e-b96a-01db43e012b3.description: Gather your friends, with the sole aim of unlocking your Savoyard aperitif locked in an enormous icebox. Are you up to the challenge?

7337a6b6-b594-4d21-bf14-f9f75c99fb40.name: Aquatic Center
7337a6b6-b594-4d21-bf14-f9f75c99fb40.description: Prepare your bathing suits! Morzine's pool complex and outdoor pools are perfect for those looking to escape the heat or take a break from the slopes!

be7163d2-8e21-49fc-b66c-9b6d5d531621.name: Wellness Area at the Aquatic Center
be7163d2-8e21-49fc-b66c-9b6d5d531621.description: Come and unwind in our relaxing spa, covering 160m², comprising of 2 steam rooms and 3 saunas

c488c091-15bd-4535-a535-be4af32c4811.name: Kids' Area - Woody
c488c091-15bd-4535-a535-be4af32c4811.description: WOODY offers a 200 m² children's area, entirely dedicated to younger guests: ball pool, slide, Ninja Warrior kids...

8657b561-aa05-46f3-ab62-177428ed29b9.name: Slate Mine Morzine exhibition
8657b561-aa05-46f3-ab62-177428ed29b9.description: With the help of a large selection of photos, discover the history of the slate mines in Morzine. This limestone formed in the Alpine ocean, has been mined for more than three centuries by the locals.

5f2ed92c-87bc-4b15-a799-ef8af3d3b59e.name: Smart Darts - Woody
5f2ed92c-87bc-4b15-a799-ef8af3d3b59e.description: Connected darts revisit the traditional game with an interactive system offering several game modes and automatic score counting.

135b626c-3bad-4389-8700-109e24cfb082.name: Heli-skiing
135b626c-3bad-4389-8700-109e24cfb082.description: As we are situated close to Italy and Switzerland it allows us to do Heli-skiing in the Mont Blanc area. Only taken back skiers flight are allowed in the french side of the Portes du Soleil.

901224fd-68f1-45fb-9645-4108cc8c76ec.name: Indiana'Ventures - Nocturnal toboggan ride
901224fd-68f1-45fb-9645-4108cc8c76ec.description: When night falls and skiers have gone home, fly down Pleney's slopes with a sledge and headtorch. It's a madcap, steep descent taking in 4km of ski trails overlooking Morzine.

2f91de1d-9fc3-43c7-ac5c-a504df0e4435.name: Indiana'Ventures -Outdoor skating rink
2f91de1d-9fc3-43c7-ac5c-a504df0e4435.description: Discover Morzine's outdoor skating rink: the perfect place for magical moments this winter!

934e406c-4ab9-42a2-880d-c850da14e4da.name: Indiana'Ventures -Snowshoe outing
934e406c-4ab9-42a2-880d-c850da14e4da.description: Discover the moutain through a relaxing activity. Wear your snowshoes and here we go.

9566d2e3-2b14-415d-a880-b2e8dc780646.name: Indiana'Ventures -Yooner
9566d2e3-2b14-415d-a880-b2e8dc780646.description: Indiana'Venture has a great new way of enjoying the snow: Yooner sledging is exciting from the moment you set off! The Yooner is light, easy to steer and comfortable.

7b400689-d44d-4fa6-bdda-654d2f96ac0e.name: Introduction to Biathlon with ESF
7b400689-d44d-4fa6-bdda-654d2f96ac0e.description: As an initiation session or as a group lesson, the ESF in Morzine offers the sport of biathlon. Don't hesitate to contact us if you would like to discover this activity which combines laser shooting with cross country skiing.

98ac3712-6c8d-4a6e-b9a9-4a5342b5254e.name: JIM FISHING GUIDE
98ac3712-6c8d-4a6e-b9a9-4a5342b5254e.description: Certified fishing guide in Haute-Savoie offering guided fishing trips on rivers and lakes. Trout and predator fishing, various techniques and an outstanding natural environment.

9d37fc4b-ace4-4935-8c5b-e466db3828f6.name: Karaoke - Woody
9d37fc4b-ace4-4935-8c5b-e466db3828f6.description: Two private karaoke rooms allow you to sing freely in a festive and intimate atmosphere.

c2876149-0c9c-4825-a463-78069c61d489.name: Montriond Lake
c2876149-0c9c-4825-a463-78069c61d489.description: This stunning lake - known also as the emerald green lake - sits quietly at the foot of immense cliffs and is a favourite with children and adults thanks to the idyllic vision it offers and the feeling of calm it evokes.

270bbea3-069d-4268-ae9e-86c60219c215.name: Montriond Lake in winter
270bbea3-069d-4268-ae9e-86c60219c215.description: Immerse yourself in Montriond Lake's Frozen North setting as you take in the vast expanse of snow at the foot of immense cliffs…during the cold months Lake Montriond offers a dazzling winter coat thanks to a frozen layer of ice -- make sure you see it!

230863af-56ab-411e-8201-a85831ec67aa.name: Mines d'or lake
230863af-56ab-411e-8201-a85831ec67aa.description: Located at the bottom of the Manche Valley, about 15 minutes from the center of Morzine, this small bucolic lake benefits from a very pleasant environment conducive to walks with its passes, mountain pastures and coniferous forests that surround it.

c266fea6-7717-499d-88aa-99b79b2b362f.name: Axe Throwing - Woody
c266fea6-7717-499d-88aa-99b79b2b362f.description: An original and convivial activity, axe throwing allows you to discover a fun discipline based on precision and control of movement.

4daa07b3-d15a-46ff-b73c-18e263da6c01.name: Laser Tag - Woody
4daa07b3-d15a-46ff-b73c-18e263da6c01.description: Immerse yourself in a 300 m² arena where strategy and adrenaline meet. Equipped with vests and interactive lasers, players compete in a dynamic environment suitable for all.

356af49c-e652-4732-9f34-258216134b8d.name: Le Room Escape Game
356af49c-e652-4732-9f34-258216134b8d.description: Morzine’s first Escape Room experience, Le ROOM is a live 60-minute adventure. Your team has an hour to solve the challenges, complete the mission and escape.

4c86bb5a-2ba4-4c6e-a873-8a02ea681b03.name: Private lessons Ski / Off piste with Adrénaline Ski School
4c86bb5a-2ba4-4c6e-a873-8a02ea681b03.description: Adrenaline Morzine ski school is for all ages, kids ski from 4 to 99’s adult participant.

ad837581-9ed9-424d-a7c5-ff3378f083e3.name: Les Gets-Morzine
ad837581-9ed9-424d-a7c5-ff3378f083e3.description: In the Portes du Soleil Territory, discover the Les Gets-Morzine ski area: 68 slopes and 50 lifts as well as numerous mountain restaurants.

97b859b2-8e54-4c58-b3cd-7be3faf2a8a0.name: Night sledging with Alpi'Raquettes & Luge
97b859b2-8e54-4c58-b3cd-7be3faf2a8a0.description: 1 descent of 5km in complete safety… Sledge + Helmet + Headlamp ''Gliding at Night under the Stars''

80e28853-e781-4fac-8c09-0382fd9829bb.name: Moonbike
80e28853-e781-4fac-8c09-0382fd9829bb.description: Go for a ride in Avoriaz on a fast, silent and easy to handle machine. On a marked out course, enjoy a guided ride and add fun to your vacations! The mountain is waiting for you.

e1534f0d-bfce-4532-8ddf-74252cec7b6d.name: Mechanical Music Museum
e1534f0d-bfce-4532-8ddf-74252cec7b6d.description: Come to discover the incredible mechanical instruments collection of the museum. More than 1000 pieces are exposed : carillons, clocks, music boxes, orchestrions, mechanical pianos, stringed instruments, barrel organs, automates, phonographes...

91f0f0a7-a1da-4af3-96aa-2ad6b446871e.name: Padel
91f0f0a7-a1da-4af3-96aa-2ad6b446871e.description: Two artificial turf paddleball courts in a modern, friendly setting, ideal for paddleball in Morzine.

9a2b2e46-ccfe-4743-b637-7c86f303ed34.name: Sports Hall
9a2b2e46-ccfe-4743-b637-7c86f303ed34.description: The Palais des Sport offers a large choice of rooms able to accomodate 20 to 700 people. The rooms can be used for seminars, workshops, weddings and dinner receptions

e1d8b332-1a2b-4b27-8c46-fbbeea6cfcbd.name: Dereches Park
e1d8b332-1a2b-4b27-8c46-fbbeea6cfcbd.description: The Park des Dérêches has its own internet site, listing all the details of the sports you can participate in, in this preserved area of Morzine. Parc des Dérêches is a piece of nature that has grown with the village and emerges along the river.

e5bb1d98-2e78-4cfc-b604-7248581fff1e.name: Ceramic Painting: "Mountain Adventure" by ESI Morzine
e5bb1d98-2e78-4cfc-b604-7248581fff1e.description: Discover ceramic painting, a creative and fun activity that lets you personalize your own items while enjoying a relaxing experience. Take home a one-of-a-kind creation you made yourself—to give as a gift or keep as a memento.

077e9517-fddb-4f0d-ab44-b1d782737d39.name: Little Train
077e9517-fddb-4f0d-ab44-b1d782737d39.description: Line between Morzine Tourist Office and Palais des Sports in summer. Line between the gondala of Super Morzine and the Pleney in winter.

14b1bdca-52ae-4e32-9945-ecb0b3b2b71f.name: Meuniers fish farm
14b1bdca-52ae-4e32-9945-ecb0b3b2b71f.description: Visit the fish farm for a closer look at what they do and to learn about the fish in our mountain lakes and streams: arctic char and faro trout. You’ll also see rainbow trout and brook trout.

a9692f20-9bd2-412a-95a6-fe2d7ddb0954.name: "Who Wants to Win Reblochons?
a9692f20-9bd2-412a-95a6-fe2d7ddb0954.description: WHO WANTS TO WIN SOME REBLOCHONS? The VACHEment gourmand game show! Parody, revisit, variation: these are 3 words that could sum up our new offbeat TV game show concept: ‘Who Wants to Win the Reblochons’.

f17bdd86-d121-4e8c-9abf-8a62d4e1efea.name: Hiking with ADRÉNALINE Ski School
f17bdd86-d121-4e8c-9abf-8a62d4e1efea.description: Full day or half day hiking to discover the nature . We will find the best track according to your expectations. If you have any special request do not hesitate to contact us.

df6e34ce-1888-4f0e-9b54-023556546c4d.name: Fitness
df6e34ce-1888-4f0e-9b54-023556546c4d.description: Group fitness sessions and Personal Training. Suitable for all levels.

145af2b7-610c-439c-be4e-39d97ae6c3f8.name: La Battante Nature Trail
145af2b7-610c-439c-be4e-39d97ae6c3f8.description: Discover the route between the church and La Battante while having fun and learning more about Morzine's heritage.

8b3ceae4-c6c2-455f-94e9-1d9323ab043c.name: Shinrin Yoku (forest bathing) and snow
8b3ceae4-c6c2-455f-94e9-1d9323ab043c.description: This is a wonderful slow walk through nature, on snowshoes, taking the time to consider and notice the wonderful and beautiful things often not observed when walking at normal pace.

2f9b3a83-aa3d-46a3-bc20-d7e8a95c9bac.name: Ski touring with the guide bureau
2f9b3a83-aa3d-46a3-bc20-d7e8a95c9bac.description: The Morzine-Avoriaz Guide Bureau offers safe ski touring in the Portes du Soleil area.

dd2ceb97-b5f4-4a8e-88f5-258a0a3d2394.name: Ski de randonnée avec MB Ski Snowboard and Outdoor Experiences
dd2ceb97-b5f4-4a8e-88f5-258a0a3d2394.description: Ski touring with MB Ski Snowboard and Outdoor Experiences: guided trips to explore the mountains.

dff556a9-b718-4e5c-aeec-5c85b9e4dee7.name: Ski touring with SNOWTRIBE SKI & SNOWBOARD
dff556a9-b718-4e5c-aeec-5c85b9e4dee7.description: Discover the pleasure of making your own tracks.

f694af9f-2ad0-4ce5-ac6d-ca4f7a2c8535.name: Freeride ski avec le bureau des guides
f694af9f-2ad0-4ce5-ac6d-ca4f7a2c8535.description: For thrill seekers, try FREERIDE, in complete safety, with the Morzine Avoriaz guide office.

5a123a93-e367-48e8-9d20-0db512b727a5.name: Off piste skiing with Marco Deshayes
5a123a93-e367-48e8-9d20-0db512b727a5.description: Experience my knowledge of the french-swiss domain "Portes du Soleil" off piste and I will make you have a pleasant day adapted to your level.

f6966ce4-71bf-4a01-812b-dde27de0e9a8.name: Ski Joering
f6966ce4-71bf-4a01-812b-dde27de0e9a8.description: Ski-Jöering, the pleasure of skiing in a different way. Come and enjoy an unforgettable experience on skis behind a horse, in the majestic scenery of the Portes du Soleil. Several sessions are available: 30-minute initiation, 1-hour ride or 1-hour advanced session.

d1155fe5-dd77-43dc-ab8c-384f400875ca.name: Snowpark d'Arare - Nami Park
d1155fe5-dd77-43dc-ab8c-384f400875ca.description: Avoriaz's historic snowpark, created in 1993, is named Nami-Park. Nami means "wave" in Japanese and defines a new shape inspired by surfing philosophy, featuring large snow waves and original modules.

4146ad17-d9ce-4eb2-8236-be60ebcdffc2.name: Snowpark de la Chapelle
4146ad17-d9ce-4eb2-8236-be60ebcdffc2.description: La Chapelle is a snowpark for all riders. It’s the perfect place to train and improve. It features four kicker lines of different levels (XS, S, M, and L) for smooth progression, as well as two jib lines (S and L) with boxes and rails.

ddebd023-564f-480e-a790-223875cfe8b4.name: Ski touring with Adrénaline
ddebd023-564f-480e-a790-223875cfe8b4.description: Skin-up for the first time or push yourself to the next level under the guidance of a ski touring professional. Our experienced instructors show you the ropes, technique and etiquette while safely guiding you over exciting new terrain. The safety gear will be provided (Transceiver, shovel and probe)

93a0f63f-6126-4f4d-8539-a85903100d1e.name: Cross-country skiing
93a0f63f-6126-4f4d-8539-a85903100d1e.description: A nice, fun way to escape and re-discover nature. Far from the crowds, experience a great feeling of freedom.

788916b9-a770-45ec-9cbf-78caaa096069.name: Mountaineering

d6e5bf93-a829-49b6-8f08-c05aec90ea0d.description: Spend exquisite moments in this famous hotel in Morzine.

84212fe8-5cc7-4d84-858a-8c16e23302f1.name: Hotel le Soly
84212fe8-5cc7-4d84-858a-8c16e23302f1.description: Discover a Savoyard chalet combining tradition, charm and friendliness, ideal for all your holidays with friends and family, the time of your ski holidays or summer.

48a467b1-b26a-4852-926f-a15037c3333f.name: Hôtel Le Sporting
48a467b1-b26a-4852-926f-a15037c3333f.description: Typical Savoyard chalet with swimming pool, hammam, sauna and beautician center. Sporty and friendly atmosphere. Excellent home-made French typical restaurant.

b77255b8-c9be-488d-ad83-b19333b1f2a7.name: Hotel le Tremplin
b77255b8-c9be-488d-ad83-b19333b1f2a7.description: Open year-round, the Hôtel Le Tremplin is your home away from home in the mountains, in the heart of Morzine.

62f05323-51c3-4713-97b1-4677f38e582e.name: Hotel L'Equipe
62f05323-51c3-4713-97b1-4677f38e582e.description: In the center of Morzine, down the slopes & at the start of the skilifts of Le Pléney.

8ecb551e-4f25-44a7-975c-4a972f7fe7f8.name: Hôtel Les Côtes, Appartements et Chalets
8ecb551e-4f25-44a7-975c-4a972f7fe7f8.description: Hotel Les Côtes is located 500 meters from the Super-Morzine lift and 5 min walk to the church place. It combines the comfort of a 3 star hotel and the independency of a self-catered accommodation with numerous leisure facilities for free. Run by the Family Marullaz since 1951, it is the perfect spot for your next Morzine Holidays!

8597f753-25bd-4576-aaf3-e6c6136b3cc5.name: Hôtel les Fleurs
8597f753-25bd-4576-aaf3-e6c6136b3cc5.description: Family-friendly hotel enjoying a peaceful setting at the entrance to Morzine. Relaxed atmosphere, summer pool and free shuttles summer and winter to the foot of the slopes.

62ee31a7-3252-4257-840c-4af3410ec8e1.name: Hotel Les Lans
62ee31a7-3252-4257-840c-4af3410ec8e1.description: Family-run hotel at the foot of the Avoriaz slopes. At Hôtel Les Lans, we combine traditional comfort with modern amenities to meet our guests' needs, while offering a convenient and enjoyable experience.

e2711a38-7ec6-4c8e-92e6-01f518e7d9e7.name: Névé hotel
e2711a38-7ec6-4c8e-92e6-01f518e7d9e7.description: A charming hotel, welcome to Chalet Hôtel Névé in Morzine. With 37 comfortably-equipped rooms linked by elevator.

31c874ec-f61d-4d42-8397-ce976c96957d.name: Hôtel & Spa Le Dahu
31c874ec-f61d-4d42-8397-ce976c96957d.description: On the sunniest side of Morzine with a panoramic view of the village, 400 m from shops, ski lifts and activities, the Heu family welcomes you in the warmth of wood and the comfort of a large mountain chalet.

9cd78741-4e8f-4502-af20-ea428cde7e0c.name: Hôtel & Spa "Neige et Roc"
9cd78741-4e8f-4502-af20-ea428cde7e0c.description: Located in Les Prodains, at the bottom of Avoriaz's cable car, at the foot of the slopes. 4 km from the centre of Morzine.

f849b7c2-35db-4a89-82a7-324e794fcf7c.name: Le Gros Colas
f849b7c2-35db-4a89-82a7-324e794fcf7c.description: Typical Morzine chalet in the heart of the village, 200m from the Super Morzine ski lifts. Comfortable rooms with full-equiped bathroom facilities.

edb67694-73b9-4649-958f-77ac7a408175.name: Le PasSionNant
edb67694-73b9-4649-958f-77ac7a408175.description: Le PasSionNant is located in Morzine, 41 km from the Evian Resort Golf Club. It features a terrace, restaurant, bar and free private parking.

b6d32627-fdec-4c92-a34b-3efa554e8e1e.name: Les Embrunes
b6d32627-fdec-4c92-a34b-3efa554e8e1e.description: Summer and winter alike, the "Les Embrunes" vacation center welcomes you to Morzine/Avoriaz.

ed456b69-a98e-4683-b41a-e65c8c844b80.name: Les Mazots des Fées
ed456b69-a98e-4683-b41a-e65c8c844b80.description: Comfortable rooms and cosy Mazôts, for an atypical accommodation.

ba2a5cd1-5f40-4e35-8fb4-889fdc206fbd.name: Bostan mountain refuge
ba2a5cd1-5f40-4e35-8fb4-889fdc206fbd.description: Above Samoëns and isolated in the mountains, the Bostan refuge is the ideal place to welcome hikers for a short break or for the night. Accommodation and catering in the mountains. Home and local products. Pleasure for the eyes and taste buds. .

3d7abf47-8be2-40b4-86ea-b79c22227cf8.name: Golèse mountain refuge
3d7abf47-8be2-40b4-86ea-b79c22227cf8.description: The mountain hut is situated at the Col de la Golèse in the middle of an alpine meadow. It offers a wonderful panorama on the south side overlooking the Giffre valley and Samoëns and on Morzine and Manche valley on the north side.

a7445c13-43b3-463e-83f4-3b772ed36637.name: Résidence du Téléphérique d'Avoriaz
a7445c13-43b3-463e-83f4-3b772ed36637.description: 1-star Tourist Accommodation with 52 apartements located at the bottom of the Prodains Cable car (Access to Avoriaz) and at 4 km from Morzine center.

f79e2cd1-87ed-4f42-b9d8-e94689985ac0.name: Résidence Frond'Neige
f79e2cd1-87ed-4f42-b9d8-e94689985ac0.description: The Résidence Frond'Neige **** is a charming Savoyard chalet located at the foot of the Pléney slopes and in the center of the resort. Ideally located next to the Pléney cable car and just a few meters from shops and restaurants, everything is within easy walking distance.

74f9cc78-a5f2-4e35-8e49-3fdbc840cb0b.name: Residence l'Aiglon
74f9cc78-a5f2-4e35-8e49-3fdbc840cb0b.description: Ideally located in the heart of the traditional Savoyard village of Morzine, L'Aiglon is a magnificent "tourism residence" with 12 x 4* self-contained apartments.

0f50e40a-ab7e-4660-a389-f1404f576158.name: Village Club Miléade l'Hauturière
0f50e40a-ab7e-4660-a389-f1404f576158.description: The Village Club *** Miléade enjoys an exceptional location in the heart of the village. With full-board accommodation, you'll enjoy a vacation rich in experiences and tailored to every member of the family.

cc539f27-4492-4ab5-93fd-8caf45f853a5.name: Villages clubs du Soleil - Le Florimontane
cc539f27-4492-4ab5-93fd-8caf45f853a5.description: All-inclusive stays for families, individuals and groups.

250ee403-7511-47a8-850b-7fd01503bb1a.name: Gold Mines Lake walk - Snowshoe trail
250ee403-7511-47a8-850b-7fd01503bb1a.description: Starting from the Erigné car park in front of Morzine, this route leads to the Mines d'Or lake and the Fréterolle chalets, as far as the Chardonnière torrent. Return along the Dranse de la Manche.

f3c6bed1-f949-4bf6-9a2a-c7a1934e7544.name: Col de la Golèse via the refuge
f3c6bed1-f949-4bf6-9a2a-c7a1934e7544.description: Set off for a beautiful escapade in the heart of the alpine pastures with this accessible hike to the La Golèse refuge.

bc49b57b-32ac-41a3-bf4c-d4b8d7f32f7d.name: From l'Erigné to Chardonnière
bc49b57b-32ac-41a3-bf4c-d4b8d7f32f7d.description: Start from l’Erigné in the Manche Valley, at the end of the snow-cleared part of the road. Follow the cross-country ski tracks that go up via the bridge to Charny.

48c534db-5b43-4e84-9abc-1faf08bd5d2f.name: From l'Erigné to Fréterolles
48c534db-5b43-4e84-9abc-1faf08bd5d2f.description: Set off from l’Erigné in the Manche Valley at the end of the snow-cleared part of the road. Follow the cross-country ski tracks that go up via the bridge to Charny.

0f5996a6-40d1-4c18-a3e0-47bfc5210999.name: From Pléney to Chavannes
0f5996a6-40d1-4c18-a3e0-47bfc5210999.description: Start by going up in the Pléney cable-car (access fee). At the exit of the gondola, climb on the left to join the groomed piste reserved for walkers next to the beginners area, pass the orientation table under the Belvédère chairlift to reach the Vaffieu restaurant.

92f10152-9e8f-43e1-bb32-44c8ceaa3f8e.name: Le Vanné ski touring route
92f10152-9e8f-43e1-bb32-44c8ceaa3f8e.description: Beautiful panoramic view at the summit over the Chablais mountains (especially stunning at sunset). Departure from the village of Lindarets. Arrival at the top of the Lindarets Ridge via the Brochaux.

64b2a63b-a7d3-4eb4-b559-56c72d3b1e24.name: Les Jordières ski touring itinerary
64b2a63b-a7d3-4eb4-b559-56c72d3b1e24.description: Walk through the Crot forest. Departure at the base of the Prodains cable car, arrival at the top of the Prodains cable car.

859b27f1-6ba2-48b4-bf6b-7217267d3284.name: Treasure hunt
859b27f1-6ba2-48b4-bf6b-7217267d3284.description: Fan of track game? The Morzine Tourist Office has set up a free virtual treasure hunt to explore the village and its heritage in an interactive way.

1f28031f-c00f-432a-b232-29cbf3927118.name: Montriond lake to Ardent
1f28031f-c00f-432a-b232-29cbf3927118.description: This route is possible on foot or with snowshoes. All walkers will enjoy taking the open lakeside path, since it is groomed and easier to walk along.

9c9fe9af-8e25-45ae-a8ee-5cf07a954bf1.name: Le Pleney on snowshoes
9c9fe9af-8e25-45ae-a8ee-5cf07a954bf1.description: This walk offers magnificent panoramic views over the Morzine and Manche valleys, the Plateau de Nyon and Avoriaz.

64205dca-9fcc-4eb3-b52b-c5f3b9ea1b47.name: Fox trail
64205dca-9fcc-4eb3-b52b-c5f3b9ea1b47.description: A nature walk along the Dranse river following the former Alpine trail to Nyon. Looking out for foxes along the way which are native to this valley. In the winter this path can also be used for showshoeing

dab93f59-db9e-41da-a677-92fa3d54939f.name: Nature Trail and Fox Watching - snowshoe trail
dab93f59-db9e-41da-a677-92fa3d54939f.description: Start from the church and cross over the old bridge, go below the road via the metal bridge and to the first information board.

23b61511-24eb-43fe-90e8-0df46b5d1118.name: The peaks of Super Morzine and the belvedere of the lake
23b61511-24eb-43fe-90e8-0df46b5d1118.description: From Avoriaz, head for the Falaise district. Pass between the Malinka and Saskia residences, head towards Le Proclou, over the golf course and up to the Col de la Joux Verte.

497bcb2d-697a-4288-b245-9a417891b9ba.name: Orienteering race
497bcb2d-697a-4288-b245-9a417891b9ba.description: From the starting point near the swimming pool entrance, there is no defined circuit, simply find the 20 tags (posts with clips) within a set time. Maps are available at the Morzine Tourist Office, the Palais des Sports.

84672cb3-d010-4eb4-9ccc-ebee20c83686.name: Walk in Dérêches Park
84672cb3-d010-4eb4-9ccc-ebee20c83686.description: Tucked away in the heart of Morzine, the Parc des Dérêches walk offers a natural interlude through the seasons. Running alongside the River Dranse, this peaceful stroll appeals to families and sports enthusiasts alike.

9be6bc5d-f31b-47fd-8fd5-d2b53c963987.name: Cross-country skiing at Pléney-Chavannes
9be6bc5d-f31b-47fd-8fd5-d2b53c963987.description: The Pléney-Chavannes sector offers a hilly circuit over approximately 4,5km with a double track preparation for cross-country skiers.The technical nature of this route makes it ideal for cross-country training.

61b3ace4-b2b9-4c9c-ba91-df6c540dd43f.name: Cross-country skiing in vallée de la Manche - col de Coux-Paradis
61b3ace4-b2b9-4c9c-ba91-df6c540dd43f.description: The route from Nyon from l’Erigné is suitable for everyone. Access by car or free shuttle (N or E circuits, “telepherique de Nyon” stop).

180455cf-1cf3-4015-b0df-ae7979d95c3c.name: Tête de Bostan from Morzine
180455cf-1cf3-4015-b0df-ae7979d95c3c.description: Set out to conquer an iconic peak in the Chablais Mountains: the Tête de Bostan via the Col (2,406 m).

2d4b68e8-be17-470f-9830-d6a8eca0e194.name: The Stash
2d4b68e8-be17-470f-9830-d6a8eca0e194.description: Situated in the middle of a large expanse of un-groomed snow, it is ideal for trying out wide turns in powder snow. These slopes wind in and out of the trees in the Lindaret forest and are punctuated with hidden wooden obstacles all around the circuit.

b55bc64e-568d-4f6d-8797-f0d8ef974c62.name: TOUR DU LAC MOUILLE AU BLÉ

42a2e023-22fd-4c73-a99e-31bc972dc302.name: Abeille
42a2e023-22fd-4c73-a99e-31bc972dc302.description: This red run drops from 1,440 m to 1,210 m over 710 m. It starts at the top of the Pléney gondola and is steep in places.

00c69009-a567-456f-a536-6e9f2a8c7396.name: ABRICOTINE
00c69009-a567-456f-a536-6e9f2a8c7396.description: This blue run drops from 2,230 m to 1,700 m over 4.1 km. It is the longest run in Avoriaz and suits all levels.

7b9c76a6-6f17-41d9-9a33-1b71c3741f78.name: Accès domaine skide fond
7b9c76a6-6f17-41d9-9a33-1b71c3741f78.description: This snowshoe trail runs 1.0 km between 1,760 m and 1,800 m. It leads to the cross-country ski area.

bef10171-2390-4837-9b7e-91042f2066d5.name: Accès Eagle Park
bef10171-2390-4837-9b7e-91042f2066d5.description: This red run drops from 1,520 m to 1,470 m over 390 m. It is a link run and starts at the top of the Raverettes chairlift.

dda3ae99-b701-4923-bb3a-6175c3e2f06c.name: Accès Ecole
dda3ae99-b701-4923-bb3a-6175c3e2f06c.description: This blue run drops from 1,230 m to 1,200 m over 200 m. It is a link run.

3a01a952-f090-4eae-a774-16a9d112164f.name: accès Pré-Favre
3a01a952-f090-4eae-a774-16a9d112164f.description: This blue run is 70 m long and almost flat, at about 1,180 m. It is a link run and ends at the Pré Favre chairlift.

6c9c2f0e-44e1-4d42-9aad-1ec81de05200.name: Accès TS Chéry Nord
6c9c2f0e-44e1-4d42-9aad-1ec81de05200.description: This blue run is 200 m long and almost flat, at about 1,430 m. It is a link run and ends at the Chéry Nord chairlift.

62efe0a3-c5af-4883-b7ee-52c0eb25f7d5.name: ALLER CHAVANETTE
62efe0a3-c5af-4883-b7ee-52c0eb25f7d5.description: This blue run drops from 1,930 m to 1,800 m over 1.3 km. It is a link run.

c1a1d4e9-3bd6-48b4-8717-00323c52eb2c.name: ALPAGES
c1a1d4e9-3bd6-48b4-8717-00323c52eb2c.description: This red run drops from 2,140 m to 1,960 m over 490 m. It starts at the top of the Choucas chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

64c11839-accd-45e0-a6d9-59d6011e23f3.name: AMBRESALLES
64c11839-accd-45e0-a6d9-59d6011e23f3.description: This red run drops from 1,640 m to 1,410 m over 1.0 km. It runs from the top of the Nauchets Express chairlift down to the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

c8b1865b-4137-4e62-b602-c2f1d821b884.name: ARETE DES INTRETS
c8b1865b-4137-4e62-b602-c2f1d821b884.description: This black run drops from 1,920 m to 1,410 m over 1.2 km. It is steep in places.

294adeba-50b9-4419-9e39-b8c8fe49edbf.name: ARNICA
294adeba-50b9-4419-9e39-b8c8fe49edbf.description: This red run drops from 1,690 m to 1,530 m over 670 m.

aedcb931-38b3-46fc-bf2e-c360d82717ae.name: Bellemouille
aedcb931-38b3-46fc-bf2e-c360d82717ae.description: This red run drops from 1,610 m to 1,390 m over 1.0 km. It starts at the top of the Chavannes Express chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

d4afc719-c3d0-4e00-8506-f21d5f75bacc.name: BLANCHOTS
d4afc719-c3d0-4e00-8506-f21d5f75bacc.description: This blue run drops from 2,140 m to 2,050 m over 370 m. It starts at the top of the Choucas chairlift.

a1c46cc2-f145-481c-8b67-ef051f6fa930.name: BLEUE CHAVANETTE
a1c46cc2-f145-481c-8b67-ef051f6fa930.description: This blue run drops from 2,140 m to 1,860 m over 1.4 km. It starts at the top of the Chavanette 1 drag lift.

f23b74c5-36ad-4834-9c9e-31b2b217f979.name: BLEUE D'ARARE
f23b74c5-36ad-4834-9c9e-31b2b217f979.description: This blue run drops from 2,200 m to 1,740 m over 2.6 km. It runs from the top of the Grandes Combes chairlift down to the Tour chairlift.

0af60f01-7041-4ea3-9735-34d95214f7aa.name: BLEUE DU LAC
0af60f01-7041-4ea3-9735-34d95214f7aa.description: This blue run drops from 2,150 m to 1,930 m over 1.1 km. It starts at the top of the Arare 2 drag lift.

0c19c977-6798-4fb4-9401-a566ec08ad86.name: BLEUET
0c19c977-6798-4fb4-9401-a566ec08ad86.description: This blue run drops from 1,180 m to 980 m over 5.0 km. It is mostly flat.

c107d729-7385-4c54-b827-899a6ce3b95d.name: BLUE VELVET
c107d729-7385-4c54-b827-899a6ce3b95d.description: This blue run drops from 1,990 m to 1,600 m over 1.4 km. It starts at the top of the Brochaux chairlift and is steep in places.

39c5a22f-01cb-4fb4-a536-16e95d83f568.name: Boarder Déborah Anthonioz
39c5a22f-01cb-4fb4-a536-16e95d83f568.description: This red run drops from 1,350 m to 1,250 m over 610 m. It is a permanent boardercross course, reached from the Chavannes gondola by the Gentiane run.

99d730eb-dfc1-4fe3-9378-7fb8a5707eb2.name: Boardercross de Nyon
99d730eb-dfc1-4fe3-9378-7fb8a5707eb2.description: This boardercross course drops from 1,460 m to 1,420 m over 260 m. It starts at the top of the Poireaux 1 drag lift.

0556b282-e70d-4be6-99de-aef8ff3f6cb5.name: BOULEVARD SKIEURS
0556b282-e70d-4be6-99de-aef8ff3f6cb5.description: This blue run drops from 1,830 m to 1,770 m over 660 m. It runs from the top of the Dromonts 1 drag lift down to the Plateau chairlift.

d031efb3-2b2c-4e7e-a490-dc37edd656e4.name: BOUQUETIN
d031efb3-2b2c-4e7e-a490-dc37edd656e4.description: This black run drops from 1,710 m to 1,400 m over 900 m. It is usually left ungroomed and starts at the top of the Planeys chairlift.

8863749e-cccd-4bf0-a628-0292195188ee.name: BRUYERE
8863749e-cccd-4bf0-a628-0292195188ee.description: This blue run drops from 1,610 m to 1,160 m over 3.5 km. It runs from the top of the Chavannes Express chairlift down to Les Gets village.

cacf3c37-254b-4fa3-9873-9773881f7b98.name: CABRI
cacf3c37-254b-4fa3-9873-9773881f7b98.description: This red run drops from 1,960 m to 1,480 m over 1.7 km. It starts at the top of the Chamossière chairlift and is steep in places.

598c66ea-47fa-479d-a66f-88c92bad482a.name: CAMPANULE
598c66ea-47fa-479d-a66f-88c92bad482a.description: This blue run drops from 1,620 m to 1,440 m over 740 m.

cf85141e-d5ef-465f-b9a1-8a6c533d118e.name: CASCADE
cf85141e-d5ef-465f-b9a1-8a6c533d118e.description: This blue run drops from 1,670 m to 1,590 m over 660 m. It ends at the Brochaux chairlift.

ecb02f87-0b85-4f45-b770-68404f53621e.name: CHAMOIS
ecb02f87-0b85-4f45-b770-68404f53621e.description: This red run drops from 1,810 m to 1,170 m over 2.7 km. It runs from the top of the Pointe du Chéry chairlift down to Les Gets village.

d75bf465-bcba-410a-8572-4ceed7ba2c67.name: Champ de ski plateau 2
d75bf465-bcba-410a-8572-4ceed7ba2c67.description: This green run drops from 1,850 m to 1,820 m over 260 m. It starts at the top of the Écoles 2 drag lift and is gentle all the way.

07fb8884-6f5b-44b3-bebd-84b5ebfd26fd.name: CHAMP SKI BARMETTES
07fb8884-6f5b-44b3-bebd-84b5ebfd26fd.description: This green run drops from 1,530 m to 1,500 m over 230 m. It runs from the top of the Barmettes drag lift down to the Chaux Fleurie chairlift.

46aec7d9-1414-4741-a3db-a258fcbbf497.name: CHAMP SKI PLATEAU
46aec7d9-1414-4741-a3db-a258fcbbf497.description: This green run drops from 1,850 m to 1,820 m over 260 m. It is gentle all the way.

09609b1b-94b1-4b68-b472-dffdeb68f932.name: CHARDON BLEU
09609b1b-94b1-4b68-b472-dffdeb68f932.description: This blue run drops from 1,470 m to 1,370 m over 1.4 km. It ends at the Folliets du Golf chairlift and is gentle all the way.

65cb3ad0-6d61-46a9-a471-e862477d7a45.name: CHAUX FLEURIE
65cb3ad0-6d61-46a9-a471-e862477d7a45.description: This red run drops from 1,900 m to 1,700 m over 920 m. It starts at the top of the Chaux Fleurie chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

1b7749b3-8427-43ab-8475-d93c8827d1b2.name: CHEVREUIL
1b7749b3-8427-43ab-8475-d93c8827d1b2.description: This black run drops from 1,800 m to 1,450 m over 1.0 km. It starts at the top of the Chéry Nord chairlift and is very steep in places.

61d7d409-5bb4-4f46-839e-cb994a89a22a.name: COMBE A FLORET
61d7d409-5bb4-4f46-839e-cb994a89a22a.description: This blue run drops from 1,820 m to 1,470 m over 2.3 km.

523bfd5c-3f44-49e3-9dab-42417bd0d841.name: COMBE DU MACHON
523bfd5c-3f44-49e3-9dab-42417bd0d841.description: This black run drops from 2,190 m to 1,880 m over 890 m. It is usually left ungroomed and starts at the top of the Grandes Combes chairlift.

1748bbfa-7e1a-4a8b-a7c0-8b1604a196bd.description: This green run drops from 1,790 m to 1,660 m over 1.9 km. It is mostly flat.

17139510-f599-4dab-8d5e-98a93723a9fe.description: This snowshoe trail runs 7.1 km between 980 m and 1,390 m.

8aa24a2d-ff15-4ad7-b1f4-36c996f22782.description: This blue run drops from 1,180 m to 990 m over 2.0 km. It is a link run and runs down to Morzine village.

2ba84af7-970a-4ad3-bc98-3d3cf419a6a1.description: This blue run drops from 1,280 m to 1,230 m over 390 m. It is a link run and gentle all the way.

0ba3ad32-ac32-41b1-bfe3-aa6a1d5c73df.description: This blue run is 150 m long and almost flat, at about 1,440 m. It is a link run.

8c29b32c-40c8-4eee-9d2c-a9ebff96b257.description: This blue run drops from 1,350 m to 1,290 m over 810 m. It is a link run and gentle all the way.

7ce678ff-e930-4b99-82d6-9e185a08e180.description: This red run drops from 1,690 m to 1,410 m over 1.4 km. It ends at the Rosta chairlift.

e57dd9c6-83be-4039-8187-1043e481beb8.description: This snowshoe trail runs 2.3 km between 1,080 m and 1,210 m.

19594dd9-f7dc-486e-a545-c60572eac521.name: SNOWPARK ARARE
19594dd9-f7dc-486e-a545-c60572eac521.description: This snowpark drops from 2,150 m to 1,930 m over 890 m. Now called Nami Park, it is the park for experienced riders, with big jumps and a small half-pipe.

9ecd1b47-73a4-498b-bb67-6c3189f4a945.name: SNOWPARK CHAPELLE
9ecd1b47-73a4-498b-bb67-6c3189f4a945.description: This snowpark drops from 1,850 m to 1,820 m over 330 m. It has four kicker lines from XS to L and two lines of boxes and rails.

1a1a561a-776f-48e3-9a2f-aa83d7b18785.description: This kids' snowpark drops from 1,760 m to 1,670 m over 820 m. It sits in the Proclou forest with tree huts, wobbly bridges, small jumps and boxes.

db4d0909-c0e9-4bc4-ba4c-56819f729021.name: SNOWPARK STASH
db4d0909-c0e9-4bc4-ba4c-56819f729021.description: This forest snowpark drops from 1,810 m to 1,510 m over 1.4 km. Wooden features and a snake run wind through the Lindarets forest, reached by the Prolays chairlift.

4113effd-6533-45db-ab2f-f660e93df05b.name: Snowpark des Chavannes
4113effd-6533-45db-ab2f-f660e93df05b.description: This snowpark drops from 1,550 m to 1,520 m over 200 m. It sits near the top of the Chavannes gondola, with lines from green to black.

fd9d1ba2-149f-41fe-bebd-1c2bb512056d.description: This blue run drops from 1,220 m to 1,170 m over 230 m. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Boule de Gomme drag lift.

94b67b7e-7954-4586-9fb4-d1bd86707ca8.description: This blue run drops from 2,170 m to 1,910 m over 1.1 km. It is a race stadium and ends at the Arare1 drag lift.

91d40bff-ee87-4b0a-b0e6-0eb0d678c626.description: This red run drops from 1,810 m to 1,670 m over 500 m. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Pointe du Chéry chairlift.

b0a7df87-e0d3-45b7-9374-da5bd4efebaf.description: This red run drops from 1,790 m to 1,430 m over 1.6 km. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

c3325f82-326b-4411-8ab7-3a905b7885ce.description: This blue run drops from 1,810 m to 1,630 m over 690 m. It is a race stadium.

1c5b2cf4-fcdd-4796-b816-245d55ff06d9.description: This red run drops from 1,730 m to 1,550 m over 630 m. It is a race stadium and starts at the top of the Planeys chairlift.

891acb3b-aa60-400f-93d4-8782f1b19c03.description: This red run drops from 1,150 m to 990 m over 410 m. It is a race stadium and runs down to Morzine village.

b35dd0d0-1e3c-4262-867e-80cabffc54c6.description: This red run drops from 1,900 m to 1,750 m over 490 m. It is a race stadium and ends at the Stade chairlift.

fbf8da3d-082d-4ccf-afd2-b03b6a77f1c2.description: This red run drops from 1,770 m to 1,510 m over 1.1 km. It ends at the Prolays chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

44b42fad-a513-486d-9ec2-03c84ebdba71.description: This blue run drops from 1,740 m to 1,460 m over 1.8 km. It runs from the top of the Baron drag lift down to the Zore chairlift.

82163ede-6247-45dd-bbc5-a49ce0b7bbcc.name: The Stash sous le Télésiège
82163ede-6247-45dd-bbc5-a49ce0b7bbcc.description: This blue run drops from 1,790 m to 1,640 m over 640 m.

95636597-cb68-42f9-82ac-7169d1ded9d8.name: Tour du lac
95636597-cb68-42f9-82ac-7169d1ded9d8.description: This snowshoe trail is a 2.9 km loop between 1,060 m and 1,090 m.

c79b3646-c373-45fa-9418-0d784e6aa618.name: TRASHERS
c79b3646-c373-45fa-9418-0d784e6aa618.description: This green run drops from 1,820 m to 1,790 m over 170 m. It starts at the top of the Trashers drag lift.

71394b74-c556-40a8-af32-65023a649242.description: This blue run drops from 1,790 m to 1,400 m over 1.9 km. It starts at the top of the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

bc3c46c7-81d3-4511-a29f-b0f1635be1a8.description: This red run drops from 1,870 m to 1,730 m over 460 m. It is steep in places.

1c17bc6c-b9d1-4937-aa58-baab60ddfff1.description: This red run drops from 2,180 m to 2,060 m over 500 m. It starts at the top of the Cuboré Montriond chairlift and is steep in places.

33251712-347b-4e8f-82d9-269540cfe284.name: Variante Tetras
33251712-347b-4e8f-82d9-269540cfe284.description: This blue run drops from 1,590 m to 1,540 m over 270 m.

ff65101e-0f45-40fd-9f2d-5bd4861a2dbe.name: VAUTNA
ff65101e-0f45-40fd-9f2d-5bd4861a2dbe.description: This red run drops from 2,140 m to 1,910 m over 1.2 km. It starts at the top of the Cases chairlift.

2fed19d9-7a4a-4eaa-b831-a66c02e0901a.name: Vautna Bas
2fed19d9-7a4a-4eaa-b831-a66c02e0901a.description: This red run drops from 1,910 m to 1,730 m over 1.2 km. It ends at the Cases chairlift.

cfc09fb4-2157-4fa1-be39-54f786640cba.description: This blue run drops from 1,230 m to 1,170 m over 340 m. It starts at the top of the Vieux Chêne drag lift.

192c73ae-8b74-4c4b-b21e-2f1f63f29262.name: Village des Enfants
192c73ae-8b74-4c4b-b21e-2f1f63f29262.description: This green run is 60 m long and almost flat, at about 1,810 m. It ends at the Dromonts 2 drag lift.

09d59a1c-9f75-49cd-b8f4-ff796257a567.name: Village des Lindarets
09d59a1c-9f75-49cd-b8f4-ff796257a567.description: This blue run is 310 m long and almost flat, at about 1,490 m.

d5aff7ba-d69d-4096-b01d-b1ee554ffca5.name: VIOLETTE
d5aff7ba-d69d-4096-b01d-b1ee554ffca5.description: This blue run drops from 1,600 m to 1,390 m over 1.3 km. It runs from the top of the Chavannes Express chairlift down to the Ranfoilly Express chairlift.

08e9f8d5-0c71-4afa-8a5d-69535135fd23.name: VOROSSES
08e9f8d5-0c71-4afa-8a5d-69535135fd23.description: This blue run drops from 1,510 m to 1,210 m over 1.3 km. It starts at the top of the Turche drag lift.

9ca427d9-87e4-4c32-8fa6-2f4be97f9c71.name: YETI
9ca427d9-87e4-4c32-8fa6-2f4be97f9c71.description: This black run drops from 1,650 m to 1,400 m over 830 m. It starts at the top of the Rosta chairlift and has a few steeper pitches.

ae9639fe-92a6-404e-b7af-cbdaa2c4f76c.name: Zone de bosses Chavannes
ae9639fe-92a6-404e-b7af-cbdaa2c4f76c.description: This red run drops from 1,550 m to 1,490 m over 290 m. It is a mogul zone and ends at the Croix chairlift.

86285e67-c50d-46c1-b047-0762ec811157.name: Zone de Speed Riding
86285e67-c50d-46c1-b047-0762ec811157.description: This black run drops from 1,410 m to 1,250 m over 500 m. It is a zone set aside for speed riding, which is skiing with a small paraglider wing.

a26d209d-6fe9-46f1-8c87-e2f16b29648c.name: Zone Débutants
a26d209d-6fe9-46f1-8c87-e2f16b29648c.description: This green run drops from 1,530 m to 1,500 m over 230 m. It is a beginner area and starts at the top of the Viking moving carpet.

99a80c6d-7adf-415b-8034-7bdb52c16f78.name: ZORE
99a80c6d-7adf-415b-8034-7bdb52c16f78.description: This blue run drops from 1,740 m to 1,440 m over 1.4 km. It starts at the top of the Zore chairlift.

d7b2c130-7a97-47a7-8713-9ce175bb3b98.name: La Cascade des Délices
d7b2c130-7a97-47a7-8713-9ce175bb3b98.description: In 2021, former restaurateurs Christel and Gilles are embarking on a new adventure : The Cascade des délices food truck.

67d00bf1-a29b-4783-ae6a-abd5a871ebba.name: La Ferme de Seraussaix
67d00bf1-a29b-4783-ae6a-abd5a871ebba.description: In our store, we offer a range of products, including cheeses and cured meats made from pigs raised on the farm. Our farm sells only products from its own production (milk, cheese, charcuterie, terrines).

5cb8be9d-192e-4021-863f-0532d6fa9794.name: La Fruitière de Morzine - L'Alpage
5cb8be9d-192e-4021-863f-0532d6fa9794.description: Established since 1983 on the Route de la Plagne near the center of Morzine, we are affineurs of local cheeses and manufacturers of fresh produce.

65fedb45-42e7-437b-8c4d-64326bdc5fcc.name: Meuniers fish farm
65fedb45-42e7-437b-8c4d-64326bdc5fcc.description: Visit the fish farm for a closer look at what they do and to learn about the fish in our mountain lakes and streams: arctic char and faro trout. You’ll also see rainbow trout and brook trout.

cd690d7f-cb6e-4782-b0ba-9c475bf1be53.name: Château
cd690d7f-cb6e-4782-b0ba-9c475bf1be53.description: This drag lift climbs 440 m from 1,120 m to 1,240 m in 2 min. It now runs mainly as a backup for the Perrières Express chairlift.

6fc87068-dede-4ef4-985b-c86e93f54a6e.name: Cuboré
6fc87068-dede-4ef4-985b-c86e93f54a6e.description: This drag lift climbs 440 m from 1,970 m to 2,110 m in 3 min. Lifts in the Chavanette sector take their last riders up at 16:00, or 16:30 from 6 February.

c19cbf52-7a71-4156-abf0-3c4aae2f00da.name: FIL-NEIGE EBAUDS
c19cbf52-7a71-4156-abf0-3c4aae2f00da.description: This rope tow is 80 m long, at about 1,490 m, and the ride takes 1 min 40 s.

812fae02-a655-4f95-84de-e0aaeb395fc2.name: Fil neige ESF
812fae02-a655-4f95-84de-e0aaeb395fc2.description: This rope tow is 40 m long, at about 1,510 m, and the ride takes about 1 min. From the top you can ski down Parchets or Champ Ski Barmettes.

0ed2f9b5-0a4f-4b42-beee-b3cebd702328.name: Nyon
0ed2f9b5-0a4f-4b42-beee-b3cebd702328.description: This cable car climbs 1.1 km from the valley at 1,040 m to the Plateau de Nyon at 1,410 m in about 3 min. Open daily from 9:00 to 16:30, or 16:45 from 6 February to 5 March.

e89998c8-0d26-4e04-85b9-f22c1d95fe3f.name: Rosta
e89998c8-0d26-4e04-85b9-f22c1d95fe3f.description: This 8-seat detachable chairlift climbs 800 m from 1,410 m to 1,650 m in 2 min. It opened in December 2025 and is the first 8-seat chairlift in Les Gets.

ffc6fea0-f614-4454-9b05-aa117c63edfa.name: Stade
ffc6fea0-f614-4454-9b05-aa117c63edfa.description: This drag lift climbs 160 m from 1,170 m to 1,200 m in 1 min 30 s. From the top you can ski down Stade Carry.

dd79b258-0cbf-4f41-a8d2-9c5911ea8f85.name: TAPIS CHAVANNES
dd79b258-0cbf-4f41-a8d2-9c5911ea8f85.description: This moving carpet is 80 m long, at about 1,480 m, and the ride takes about 2 min.

e92c2eab-2690-4689-8571-0ee84198c55d.name: Tapis de l'Aiglon
e92c2eab-2690-4689-8571-0ee84198c55d.description: This moving carpet is 60 m long, at about 1,420 m, and the ride takes about 1 min. Open daily from 9:15 to 16:30, or 16:45 from 6 February to 5 March.

b2b374b8-765f-45e0-926a-31dcbbf89200.name: Tapis de Nabor
b2b374b8-765f-45e0-926a-31dcbbf89200.description: This moving carpet is 140 m long, at about 1,490 m, and the ride takes about 3 min. Open daily from 9:00 (8:45 in school holidays) to 16:45, or 17:15 from 6 February to 5 March.

The restaurant welcomes you summer and winter alike, and offers a variety of dishes. Home cooking.

3cc6576d-5e0f-42f4-92d7-60144b60454d.description: La Flamme, a restaurant offering traditional specialties and French cuisine, warmly welcomes you during the summer and winter seasons.

12194be0-5120-4363-882f-1e29168b490e.description: At La Hutte Morzine, experience unforgettable moments with DJ sets several times a week, a lively après-ski, tasty food and live sports!

a538c902-b26b-4a8b-ac6f-340171aabc52.description: The snack bar "La P'tite Pause" in Morzine offers simple, gourmet snacks, both savory and sweet, to eat in or take away!

f56b2c1b-fc76-4ced-b6b4-814414092768.description: L'Alpage du Crôt is located on the edge of the Crôt piste in Avoriaz. We offer light meals outside (crêpes, sandwiches, soups, pasta, etc.) and more elaborate dishes inside (traditional tartiflette, fondues, burgers, etc.).

92542b69-da8f-423d-8bce-664a0f398caa.name: L'arrêt d'Bus
92542b69-da8f-423d-8bce-664a0f398caa.description: L'Arrêt d'Bus is a friendly restaurant in Morzine, offering generous, gourmet cuisine in a warm atmosphere.

a0406749-9e4a-489d-821e-552676ef047d.name: L'Avalanche
a0406749-9e4a-489d-821e-552676ef047d.description: This small family restaurant has a cosy and warm atmosphere and offers home cooking with fresh products. Specialities and suggestions on the slate according to the seasons.

2776dd77-dce7-4864-92a9-a0b5fa66fd45.name: Le Clin d'oeil
2776dd77-dce7-4864-92a9-a0b5fa66fd45.description: A taste of South-West France cuisine in the Alps! Kristel and Jean-Noel offer a friendly welcome and invite you to try out some South-West specialties, as well as local ones.

a9fda8e5-4e00-4031-8b1b-9076cec91700.description: Le Colibri, your cafe bistro in Morzine, to get a coffee and many more things. Whether you are with friends or family, came and join us in our cosy restaurant to taste some delicious homemade food (with some gluten free meals option) and pastries.

8f478eae-584d-4a49-8671-3e6470649144.name: Le Comptoir des Halles
8f478eae-584d-4a49-8671-3e6470649144.description: Le Comptoir is an invitation to enjoy every moment of the day in a warm and friendly setting in the heart of Morzine.

ef05dbb7-2423-4e57-b4f1-c8c316f24249.description: Wine and tapas bar in the heart of Morzine. From coffee and croissants in the morning to a last drink on the terrace, enjoy inventive tapas, homemade pizzas and a carefully selected wine list in a warm and elegant atmosphere.

4894868e-bce7-46af-a584-1954994b7985.name: Le Grand Pré
4894868e-bce7-46af-a584-1954994b7985.description: Come and try our menu, in a warm setting in the heart of the Morzine ski domain.

cd3ef10f-cc4e-4d53-9ff3-21a17b35dd83.description: Mountain Snack-Bar-Creperie with sunny terrace and room heated over a wood fire. View of Morzine and its peaks.

af51a9d4-d432-4bc5-8aed-da17f3a684e3.description: Family-run chalet since 1974 at the summit of Le Pléney, 200m after the arrival of the cable cars. Home-made mountain cuisine. Specialities: homemade quiche, vegetarian dishes.

e57eed45-a678-4473-9815-046200d41586.description: The Restaurant du Dahu offers traditional, carefully prepared cuisine creatively reinterpreted by a passionate young chef.

bb819f18-bb00-4e2b-93e3-c5320c845d48.description: Discover Resto des Bulles in Morzine, by the Mines d’Or lake. Cozy and welcoming, it serves fondues, raclettes, and local specialties, all in a magical setting with breathtaking mountain views.

72f66db8-b31b-41ab-820f-a204aa1e2302.description: Sunny terrace, traditional cuisine, Savoyard specialties and sandwiches.

fb4962d5-89b6-491d-ba17-a34445f1417d.description: Friendly and warm pizzeria-bistro located close to the Church of Morzine.

e2391984-117b-4952-bd22-7dcd21ffd09c.description: The restaurant « Hôtel du Lac » offers, for lunch and dinner, a pleasant time with great food. The chef’s cooking, made with exceptional products, will delight everyone, young and old alike.
